anexo6.error: We could not complete the request. Recover the same submission if it is pending.
anexo6.conflicto: The case has changed. Review the current data before continuing; your entries have been kept.
anexo6.sin_permiso: You do not have access to this case. Return to your team inbox.
anexo6.no_encontrado: We could not find this case. Return to your team inbox.
anexo6.revisar: Review the referral details and case status.
anexo6.fecha_invalida: Enter a valid date up to today.
anexo6.consecuencia: This referral leaves the case status unchanged and allows it to be closed.
anexo6.inactiva: You can view recorded referrals. The current case status does not allow a new referral.
anexo6.sin_destinos: No destinations have been published. Enter the name of the service you are referring to.
anexo6.vacio: You have not prepared any referral to another service yet.
anexo6.fecha_pendiente: Waiting for confirmation of the actual date sent
anexo6.word_consecuencia: The Word document proposes today’s date and includes available data in sections 1 to 4. Complete sections 5 to 8 outside the application. Downloading it does not confirm sending.
anexo6.fecha_consecuencia: Confirm the date after signing and sending the referral outside the application.
anexo6.confirmacion: The date will be recorded in the case. Sending and signing take place outside the application.
anexo6.ayuda_texto: Choose a published destination or enter the service name if there are no options. Save the reason in the case. Download the Word document, check the data and complete assessments, the reason and interventions in sections 5 to 8. Sign and send the referral outside the application. Then confirm the actual date sent. You can record several referrals to other services.
anexo6.hecho.guardar: Proposal saved. You can now download Annex 6.
anexo6.hecho.descargar: Annex 6 downloaded. Review and complete the Word document before signing and sending it.
